safi-cedvel:20-25.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (من أقصى) attached to (جاء); (قوم) the one addressed in the vocative (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, which is omitted for lightness, and it (the yāʾ) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «جاء ... رجل» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يسعى» is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as a naʿt (adjective) of رجل.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption [Note: Or it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of رجل — it having been described — by implying قد.].
The vocative clause and its answer ... are in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اتّبعوا ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative.
(21) (من) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لا) negating; (أجرا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction — or circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
The clause «اتّبعوا ...» (the second) has no grammatical position: a badal (substitute) of the clause اتّبعوا (the first).
The clause «لا يسألكم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «هم مهتدون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause [Note: Or it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.].
(22) (الواو) conjunction; (ما) an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (لي) attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ ما; (لا) negating; (الذي) a relative noun, direct object; (الواو) conjunction; (إليه) attached to (ترجعون), and the واو in it is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «ما لي ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the answer of the vocative [Note: The original form of the speech is: ما لكم لا تعبدون (why do you not worship), but he turned the speech away from them so that it would be more readily accepted.]. The clause «لا أعبد ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «فطرني ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «إليه ترجعون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause [Note: Or conjoined to the clause ما لي لا أعبد.].
(23) (الهمزة) for interrogation, and it carries the meaning of negation — or of disapproval (inkār); (من دونه) attached to an omitted second direct object whose governor is أتّخذ; (إن) a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive; the نون in (يردن) is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya) before the yāʾ of the first person, which is omitted in keeping with the reading in continuous recitation (waṣl); (بضرّ) attached to a ḥāl of the object, i.e. "involved in harm"; (لا) negating; (تغن) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; (عنّي) attached to (تغن); (شيئا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), so it specifies its quantity [Note: It may be a direct object, the verb being made to include the meaning of تمنع (to withhold).]; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negating; (ينقذون) imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to (تغن), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the نون; the واو is the fāʿil (agent); the (نون) mentioned is for protection, and the yāʾ, omitted to suit the verse endings (fawāṣil), is the direct object.
The clause «أتّخذ ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «يردن الرحمن ...» has no grammatical position: giving the reason for what preceded.
The clause «لا تغن عنّي شفاعتهم ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis not joined with الفاء.
The clause «لا ينقذون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لا تغن ...
(24) (إذا) — with tanwīn — a particle of response [Note: Or a conditional adverb with the tanwīn of compensation, i.e. "if I worshipped other than Allah..", and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by the content of the khabar.]; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) for emphasis; (في ضلال) attached to the khabar of إنّ ...
The clause «إنّي.. لفي ضلال» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the saying.
(25) (بربّكم) attached to (آمنت); (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; the نون in (اسمعون) is for protection, and the yāʾ, omitted because of the verse endings, is the direct object.
The clause «إنّي آمنت ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «آمنت ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «اسمعون» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.:
فاسمعون

* Benefits:
- The differences between the badal (substitute) and the ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition):
1- The badal is what is intended by the judgement, and the antecedent (matbūʿ) is brought before it as a preparation for mentioning the badal; whereas in ʿaṭf bayān it is its antecedent that is intended, and the ʿaṭf bayān is brought only for clarification, so it is like the adjective.
An example of the badal: (حرر القائد صلاح الدين بيت المقدس) "The commander Ṣalāḥ al-Dīn liberated Jerusalem": the badal صلاح الدين is what is intended by the judgement. An example of ʿaṭf bayān: (جاء أبو زيد عمران) "Abū Zayd ʿImrān came": أبو زيد is what is intended by the judgement, but (عمران) came as clearer than it.
2- The ʿaṭf bayān is clearer than its antecedent, and this is not a condition in the badal.
3- They restrict ʿaṭf bayān to definite nouns or specified indefinite nouns (according to some of them), and this is not a condition in the badal.
4- In the badal you may dispense with the follower or the antecedent: your saying (جاء الشاعر خالد) "The poet Khālid came" remains sound if you drop the badal or the noun it substitutes for; this is not always valid in ʿaṭf bayān, as in (يا أيها الرجل): one does not say (يا الرجل); and (يا زيد الفاضل): one does not say (يا الفاضل); and (جارك ماتت زينب أمه) "Your neighbour — Zaynab, his mother, died": one does not say (جارك ماتت زينب). Therefore the follower in these sentences, and in their like, is ʿaṭf bayān, since it cannot validly take the place of the noun it would substitute for. And when the sentence remains sound on dropping the follower or the antecedent, the follower may validly be a badal or ʿaṭf bayān, but the more correct is to parse it as ʿaṭf bayān if it is clearer or better known than the antecedent.
5- The ʿaṭf bayān is never a follower of a clause, unlike the badal, as in His saying, the Exalted, in the verse we are dealing with: قالَ يا قَوْمِ اتَّبِعُوا الْمُرْسَلِينَ: اتَّبِعُوا مَنْ لا يَسْئَلُكُمْ أَجْراً — the second clause اتبعوا is a badal of the first clause اتبعوا — and (أَمَدَّكُمْ بِما تَعْلَمُونَ أَمَدَّكُمْ بِأَنْعامٍ وَبَنِينَ).
6- The badal differs from its antecedent in definiteness and indefiniteness, as in His saying, the Exalted: إِلى صِراطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ صِراطِ اللَّهِ and (بِالنَّاصِيَةِ ناصِيَةٍ كاذِبَةٍ خاطِئَةٍ). The ʿaṭf bayān does not differ from its antecedent in that.

safi-cedvel:26-27.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) a particle of alerting (tanbīh).
The clause «قيل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ادخل الجنّة ...» is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يا ليت قومي يعلمون» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يعلمون ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of ليت.
(27) (ما) maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar) [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive, the referring pronoun being omitted.]; (لي) attached to (غفر); (من المكرمين) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما غفر ...) is in the position of genitive by the باء, attached to (يعلمون).
The clause « (غفر) لي ربّي ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «جعلني ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause غفر لي ربّي.
Part Twenty-Three
The remainder of Sūrat Yā Sīn
from verse 28 to verse 83; Sūrat al-Ṣāffāt, its verses 182; Sūrat Ṣād, its verses 88; Sūrat al-Zumar from verse 1 to 31

safi-cedvel:28-29.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) negating; (على قومه) attached to (أنزلنا); (من بعده) attached to (أنزلنا); (جند) genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من السماء) attached to (أنزلنا) [Note: Or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of جند.]; (الواو) parenthetical; (ما) negating ...
The clause «ما أنزلنا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ما كنّا منزلين» has no grammatical position: parenthetical — or giving the reason. (إن) a particle of negation; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); the ism of (كانت) is omitted, its implied form being "the punishment" understood from the context; (الفاء) conjunction; (إذا) a particle of surprise (fujāʾa).
The clause «إن كانت إلّا صيحة ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «هم خامدون..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause كانت ...

* Rhetoric:
The implicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-makniyya): in His saying, the Exalted, «فَإِذا هُمْ خامِدُونَ»:
They are likened to fire by way of implicit metaphor, and the "dying out" (khumūd) is an imaginative attribution (takhyīl); in this there is an allusion to the living being as like a flame of fire and the dead as like ash, as Labīd said:
وما المرء إلا كالشهاب وضوئه ... يجور رمادا بعد إذ هو ساطع
(Man is but like the meteor-flame and its light: it turns to ash after it had been shining.)
And the metaphor may be an explicit, dependent metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya tabaʿiyya) in the khumūd, in the sense of coldness and stillness, because the spirit, in its terror at the Shout, is driven inward all at once, then is confined, and the innate heat is extinguished by its confinement. And perhaps in turning away from هامدون to «خامدون» there is a light allusion to the resurrection after death.

safi-cedvel:30-30.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) for the vocative and for expressing grief; (حسرة) the one addressed (munādā), resembling a muḍāf (shabīh bi-l-muḍāf), the object of lament, accusative (manṣūb); (على العباد) attached to حسرة; (ما) negating; (رسول) genitive in form, nominative in position, the fāʿil (agent) of يأتي; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (به) attached to (يستهزئون) ..
The clause «يا حسرة على العباد ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ما يأتيهم من رسول..» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «كانوا به يستهزئون..» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of يأتيهم or of its agent.
The clause «يستهزئون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

* Rhetoric:
Metaphor (istiʿāra): in His saying, the Exalted, «يا حَسْرَةً عَلَى الْعِبادِ».
The meaning is that they deserve to be grieved over by those who grieve, and that those who lament should lament over their state. Or they are grieved over on the part of the angels and the believers among the two weighty races (al-thaqalayn: mankind and jinn). And it may be from Allah the Exalted by way of metaphor, in the sense of magnifying what they brought upon themselves and afflicted themselves with, and of the extremity of His disapproval of it and His expressing wonder at it.

safi-cedvel:31-32.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation; (كم) an allusive noun for a number (kināya ʿan ʿadad), in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (قبلهم) an adverb, accusative, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of القرون [Note: Or attached to (أهلكنا).]; (من القرون) the tamyīz (specification) of كم; (إليهم) attached to the negated (يرجعون).
The clause «لم يروا..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أهلكنا ...» is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of يروا, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the declarative (كم) — and it may be interrogative.
The clause «لا يرجعون ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of أنّ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم إليهم لا يرجعون) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, attached to (أهلكناهم), i.e. أهلكناهم بأنّهم إليهم لا يرجعون "We destroyed them in that they do not return to them", i.e. We destroyed them by extirpation [Note: Ibn Hishām said this, and he rejected the view of Sībawayh that it is a badal (substitute) of (كم), because that would require (أهلكنا) to govern this maṣdar.. i.e. "We destroyed many of the generations and We destroyed their not returning", and this is not valid. Al-Zamakhsharī makes it a badal of كم in the sense of: "Did they not know the great number of Our destructions of the generations before them — their being such as do not return to them?".. And some make the interpreted maṣdar governed by an omitted verb, i.e. قضينا or حكمنا "We decreed / We ruled that they do not return".].
(الواو) conjunction; (إن) a particle of negation; (كلّ) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative [Note: Indicating generality, and the tanwīn is with the intention of annexation.]; (لمّا) for restriction, in the sense of إلّا; (جميع) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative, in the sense of مجموعون "gathered together"; (لدينا) an adverb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative, attached to جميع — or to (محضرون), which is a second khabar [Note: Or it is a naʿt (adjective) of جميع.].
The clause «إن كلّ لمّا جميع..» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause أهلكنا.

safi-cedvel:33-35.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (آية) a fronted khabar (predicate), nominative, of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (الأرض); (لهم) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of آية; (منها) attached to (أخرجنا); (الفاء) conjunction; (منه) attached to (يأكلون).
The clause «آية لهم الأرض ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أحييناها ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption [Note: Or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الأرض — or a naʿt of it.].
The clause «أخرجنا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أحييناها.
The clause «يأكلون..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أخرجنا [Note: It appears from the meaning that the clause is a naʿt of (حبّا), so the الفاء is redundant (zāʾida).].
(الواو) conjunction; (فيها) attached to an omitted second object, and (جنّات) is the first object; (من نخيل) attached to a naʿt of جنّات; the second (فيها) is attached to (فجّرنا); (من العيون) like فيها, and من is partitive.
The clause «جعلنا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أخرجنا.
The clause «فجّرنا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أخرجنا..
(اللام) for giving the reason; (يأكلوا) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the لام, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the نون, and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (من ثمره) attached to (يأكلوا), and the pronoun in ثمره refers to what was mentioned of the date-palms and grapes; (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive, conjoined to ثمره [Note: Or a particle of negation, and the clause is parenthetical.]; (الهمزة) for disapproving interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī); (الفاء) conjunction; (لا) negating ...
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يأكلوا ...) is in the position of genitive by the لام, attached to (جعلنا)..
The clause «يأكلوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «عملته أيديهم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «لا يشكرون ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. أيجحدون النعم فلا يشكرون "Do they deny the blessings and so not give thanks?".

safi-cedvel:36-36.t:
* I'rab:
(سبحان) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, accusative; (كلّها) a semantic tawkīd (emphasis) of الأزواج, accusative; (ممّا) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الأزواج, and likewise (من أنفسهم) and (مما) («the second»); (لا) negating ...
The clause « (نسبّح) سبحان ...» has no grammatical position: parenthetical, of supplication.
The clause «خلق ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «تنبت الأرض ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the first relative (ما).
The clause «لا يعلمون..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (ما).

* Rhetoric:
The art of correspondence (fann al-tanāsub): in His saying, the Exalted, «سُبْحانَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْواجَ كُلَّها».
The art of correspondence is that the speaker brings at the beginning of his speech a meaning whose import the understanding cannot grasp on its own: it is either summary (mujmal), needing detailing, or ambiguous (muwajjah), requiring explanation, or open to more than one sense (muḥtamal), its intended sense needing a preference that is attained only by its explanation and clarification. Explanation occurs in speech in several ways: sometimes it comes after a condition, or after what carries the meaning of a condition; at other times after a preposition and its genitive noun; and at times after the mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is the explanation. In this verse the soundness of explanation (ṣiḥḥat al-tafsīr) has come joined with the soundness of division (ṣiḥḥat al-taqsīm), and ordering (tartīb) and refinement (tahdhīb) are woven into them, so there are four arts in it: He, glory be to Him, put the girls (al-banāt) first [Translator's note: the text reads البنات "the girls"; النبات "the plants" (cf. «مِمَّا تُنْبِتُ الْأَرْضُ») is evidently intended.], and moved by way of eloquence to the higher, so He made the noblest of animals, which is man, second, so that mentioning him would entail the rest of the animals; then He made third His saying «وَمِمَّا لا يَعْلَمُونَ», so He moved from the particular to the general, so that it would be included under the general.

safi-cedvel:37-40.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (آية لهم.. نسلخ) like its counterpart [Note: In verse (33) of this sūra.]; (منه) attached to (نسلخ); (الفاء) conjunction; (إذا) of surprise (fujāʾiyya).
The clause «آية لهم الليل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «نسلخ ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption [Note: See the i'rab of the clause (أحييناها) in verse 33, for this is the counterpart of that.].
The clause «هم مظلمون..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause نسلخ.
(الواو) conjunction; (الشمس) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الليل, nominative (marfūʿ) [Note: It may be a mubtadaʾ (subject).]; (لمستقرّ) attached to (تجري), by making it include the meaning of تنتهي "it ends"; (لها) attached to مستقرّ; (ذلك) mubtadaʾ, its khabar (predicate) being تقدير; (العليم) a naʿt (adjective) of العزيز, genitive.
The clause «تجري ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption [Note: Or it is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الشمس).].
The clause «ذلك تقدير ...» has no grammatical position: giving the reason.
(الواو) conjunction; (القمر) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by what follows it, i.e. أنزلنا — or خلقنا; (منازل) second direct object, accusative, by making قدّرنا include the meaning of صيّرنا "We made it become", and that with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. ذا منازل "having stations" [Note: Or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the third-person pronoun in (قدّرنا) with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. ذا منازل; and it is permissible that [Translator's note: the footnote breaks off here in the source.]; (حتّى) a particle of limit and a preposition; (كالعرجون) attached to a ḥāl of the agent of عاد.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن عاد ...) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (قدّرناه).
The clause « (أنزلنا) القمر ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause آية لهم الليل.
The clause «قدّرناه ...» has no grammatical position: explicative.
The clause «عاد ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن).
(لا) negating, inoperative (muhmala); (الشمس) mubtadaʾ, nominative, its khabar being the clause ينبغي; (لها) attached to (ينبغي); (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تدرك ...) is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of ينبغي.
(الواو) conjunction; (لا الليل) like لا الشمس, and the khabar is (سابق); (كلّ) mubtadaʾ, nominative [Note: It conveys generality, and the tanwīn in it is with the intention of annexation.]; (في فلك) attached to (يسبحون).
The clause «لا الشمس ينبغي..» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «ينبغي» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الشمس).
The clause «تدرك ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «لا الليل سابق ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لا الشمس ...
The clause «يسبحون..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (كلّ).

* Morphology:
(37) مظلمون: plural of مظلم, i.e. entering into darkness; an active participle of the four-letter verb أظلم; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(39) العرجون: a non-derived noun (ism jāmid) for the stalk of the date-palm or its bunch; its pattern is فعلول with ḍamma on the fāʾ and the lām and sukūn on the ʿayn between them.

* Rhetoric:
1- Metaphor (istiʿāra): in His saying, the Exalted, «نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ النَّهارَ».
The original sense of salkh is stripping the skin off something like a sheep; it was borrowed for removing the light from the place of the night and where its darkness and its shade are cast — an explicit, dependent metaphor (istiʿāra tabaʿiyya muṣarraḥa). The common factor is what is understood of one thing following upon another: the appearance of the flesh follows upon stripping off the skin, and the appearance of darkness follows upon removing the light from the place of the night. And there may be an implicit metaphor (istiʿāra makniyya) in "the day", and an imaginative metaphor (istiʿāra takhyīliyya) in "the stripping".
2- The loose simile (al-tashbīh al-mursal): in His saying, the Exalted, حَتَّى عادَ كَالْعُرْجُونِ الْقَدِيمِ».
He has likened the crescent moon to the base of the date-cluster stalk; al-ʿidhq, with kasra on the ʿayn, is the kibāsa, and the kibāsa is the bunch of the date-palm. It is a marvellous simile for the crescent, for the ʿurjūn, when it grows old, becomes thin, bends and turns yellow, and these are the points of resemblance between the crescent and the ʿurjūn: it resembles it to the eye in thinness, not in size, and in curving and yellowness. This is a likening of the sensible to the sensible, for the two terms, namely the moon and the ʿurjūn, are both perceptible to the senses.

* Benefits:
- Omission of the preposition:
1- This is frequent and regular with (أنّ) and (أن), as in His saying, the Exalted: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا, i.e. بأن; and likewise بَلِ اللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَداكُمْ, i.e. بأن هداكم; and وَ الَّذِي أَطْمَعُ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ لِي, i.e. بأن يغفر لي; and أَنَّ الْمَساجِدَ لِلَّهِ, i.e. (لأن المساجد لله); (أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذا مِتُّمْ), i.e. بأنكم.
2- It has also come with other than these two, as in the verse we are dealing with: وَالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْناهُ مَنازِلَ, i.e. قدرنا له; and يَبْغُونَها عِوَجاً, i.e. يبغون لها; إِنَّما ذلِكُمُ الشَّيْطانُ يُخَوِّفُ أَوْلِياءَهُ, i.e. يخوفكم بأوليائه.
3- It may be omitted while the noun remains genitive, as in the saying of someone — when he was asked "How are you this morning?" — «خير», i.e. بخير "well".
And their saying (بكم درهم), i.e. بكم من درهم "for how many dirhams". And in oaths one says «الله لأفعلنّ» "By Allah, I shall surely do it".

safi-cedvel:41-44.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (آية لهم) its i'rab has passed [Note: In verse (33) of this sūra.]; (أنّا) a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters) and its ism; (في الفلك) attached to (حملنا).
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّا حملنا..) is in the position [Translator's note: the source has «في محلّ لها رفع», with a stray لها.] of nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
The clause «آية لهم أنّا حملنا» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «حملنا» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of أنّ.
(42) (الواو) conjunction; (لهم) attached to (خلقنا); (من مثله) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ما — a naʿt (adjective) placed before what it qualifies. The clause «خلقنا ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause حملنا.
The clause «يركبون..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
(43) - (الواو) conjunction; (الفاء) conjunction; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (صريخ) the ism of لا, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (لهم) attached to the khabar of لا; (لا) negating; and (الواو) in (ينقذون) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «إن نشأ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «نغرقهم..» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) not joined with الفاء.
The clause «لا صريخ لهم..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «لا هم ينقذون..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لا صريخ لهم.
The clause «ينقذون ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
(44) - (إلّا) for exception; (رحمة) accusative as a disjoined exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ) [Note: I.e. it is excepted from the most general of reasons and causes, i.e. they are not rescued for any reason except the reason of mercy.. Moreover, the exception may be emptied (mufarragh), so it is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. برحمة; or it is mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb; or it is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose)..]; (منّا) attached to رحمة; (إلى حين) attached to (متاعا).

* Morphology:
(43) صريخ: a derived adjective on the pattern فعيل in the sense of فاعل, i.e. one who calls for help; it may also come in the sense of the passive (mafʿūl).

* Rhetoric:
Soundness of invention (salāmat al-ikhtirāʿ): in His saying, the Exalted, «وَإِنْ نَشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ» up to His saying, the Exalted, «وَمَتاعاً إِلى حِينٍ». Soundness of invention is bringing a meaning to which no one has preceded. Their rescue from drowning by a mercy from Him, the Exalted, is in itself an enjoyment which they enjoy, but it is in any case until an appointed term at which they will die, from which they have no escape; so if they are saved from drowning, they will not be saved from what resembles it or comes near it, and in death there is no difference.

safi-cedvel:45-46.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (لهم) attached to (قيل); (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بين) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما; (الواو) conjunction; (ما خلفكم) like ما بين.. so it is conjoined to it; and (الواو) in (ترحمون) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The conditional clause, its protasis and its apodosis ... have no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause إن نشأ «1».
The clause «قيل ...» is in the position of genitive as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by His saying, the Exalted, in the following verse: كانوا عنها معرضين, i.e. أعرضوا "they turned away".
The clause «اتّقوا ...» is in the position of nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil [Note: It is originally the clause that is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).].
The clause «لعلّكم ترحمون..» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «ترحمون..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ.
(46) - (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating; (آية) genitive in form, nominative in position, the fāʿil (agent) of تأتي; (من آيات) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of آية; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (عنها) attached to معرضين, the khabar..
The clause «ما تأتيهم من آية ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause إن نشأ «3».
The clause «كانوا عنها معرضين..» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object or of the agent.

safi-cedvel:47-47.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذا قيل لهم أنفقوا) like إذا قيل لهم اتّقوا «1»; (ممّا) attached to (أنفقوا) [Note: (ما) may be a relative noun with the referring pronoun omitted, or a maṣdar-forming particle, the interpreted maṣdar being in the position of genitive, attached to (أنفقوا).]; (للذين) attached to (قال); (الهمزة) for interrogation; (من) a relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لو) a conditional particle that does not put the verb in the jussive; (إن) a particle of negation; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (في ضلال) attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of أنتم..
The conditional clause, its protasis and its apodosis ... have no grammatical position: conjoined to the preceding conditional clause «3».
The clause «قيل ...» is in the position of genitive as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «أنفقوا ...» is in the position of nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) [Note: It is originally the clause that is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).].
The clause «رزقكم الله ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal or particle relative (ما).
The clause «قال الذين ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a condition that does not put the verb in the jussive.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذين) (the second).
The clause «أنطعم ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «لو يشاء الله ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «أطعمه ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of the non-jussive condition (لو).
The clause «إن أنتم إلّا في ضلال ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive; it may be part of the speech of the polytheists, or of the speech of the believers, or it is the saying of Allah to the polytheists when they replied with this answer.

* Benefits:
- Censure of miserliness:
This verse was revealed concerning the disbelievers of Quraysh. The believers said to them: "Spend on the poor what you claimed was for Allah the Exalted out of your wealth" — that is, what they had assigned to Allah of their crops and cattle — and they would answer them: أَنُطْعِمُ مَنْ لَوْ يَشاءُ اللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُ إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلالٍ مُبِينٍ. It is said that al-ʿĀṣ ibn Wāʾil al-Sahmī, when a poor man asked him, would say to him: "Go to your Lord, for He has more right to you than I", and he would say: "Allah has withheld from him; shall I then feed him?" This is among what misers cling to; they say:
"We do not give to one whom Allah has deprived." This is a false claim, because Allah the Exalted made some of creation rich and some poor as a trial for them: He withheld this world from the poor man not out of miserliness, and gave this world to the rich man not because he deserved it, and He placed in the rich man's wealth a share for the poor man in order to test the rich man by the poor man. Thus did Allah's wisdom and will require, so there is no objecting to His command, and that is in order to test us in what He has given us.

safi-cedvel:48-48.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (متى) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) هذا; (الوعد) a badal (substitute) of هذا, nominative; (كنتم) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ)..
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive..
The clause «متى هذا الوعد ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إن كنتم صادقين..» has no grammatical position: resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

safi-cedvel:49-50.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) negating; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya)..
The clause «ما ينظرون ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «تأخذهم..» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of صيحة [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of صيحة, it having been described.]. The clause «هم يخصّمون..» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the object pronoun in (تأخذهم).
The clause «يخصّمون..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (هم).
(50) - (الفاء) conjunction; (لا) negating in both places; (الواو) conjunction; (إلى أهلهم) attached to (يرجعون).
The clause «لا يستطيعون..» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يخصّمون [Note: In meaning it is a badal (substitute) of the clause يخصّمون, so it is as if the الفاء were redundant (zāʾida).].
The clause «لا ... يرجعون..» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لا يستطيعون.

* Morphology:
(يخصّمون): it contains a substitution (ibdāl); its original form is يختصمون.. the تاء was changed into a صاد after being given sukūn, then the صاد was assimilated into the صاد, and the خاء was given kasra to escape the meeting of two quiescent letters, namely the خاء and the first صاد.. Its pattern is يفتعلون.
(توصية): a regular maṣdar (verbal noun) of the four-letter verb وصّى; its pattern is تفعلة with kasra on the un-doubled ʿayn..

safi-cedvel:51-51.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (في الصور) the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (الفاء) conjunction; (إذا) of surprise (fujāʾiyya); (من الأجداث) attached to (ينسلون). (إلى ربّهم) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of ينسلون, with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. حساب ربّهم "the reckoning of their Lord".
The clause «نفخ في الصور ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ما ينظرون.
The clause «هم ... ينسلون..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause نفخ في الصور.
The clause «ينسلون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (هم).

* Morphology:
(الأجداث): plural of جدث, a non-derived noun (ism jāmid) meaning "grave"; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas, and the pattern of أجداث is أفعال.

safi-cedvel:52-52.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ويلنا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb that is not in use; (من) an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) being the clause بعثنا; (من مرقدنا) attached to (بعثنا); (ما) a relative noun in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هذا, and the referring pronoun is omitted, i.e. وعد به "promised it". And صدق فيه ...
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ويلنا ...» has no grammatical position: parenthetical, of supplication.
The clause «من بعثنا..» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «بعثنا..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «هذا ما وعد الرحمن..» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «وعد الرحمن ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «صدق المرسلون..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.

* Morphology:
(مرقدنا): a noun of place from the three-letter verb رقد; its pattern is مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn, for its ʿayn takes ḍamma in the imperfect,

* Rhetoric:
The explicit, primary metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya al-aṣliyya): in His saying, the Exalted, «مَنْ بَعَثَنا مِنْ مَرْقَدِنا».
He likened death to sleep, in respect of the absence of manifest action and the rest from voluntary actions. We said it is primary only because المرقد is a mīm-maṣdar (maṣdar mīmī); if we make it a noun of place, then the metaphor is dependent (tabaʿiyya).

* Benefits:
- من: it comes in four ways:
1- Conditional: as in His saying, the Exalted, مَنْ يَعْمَلْ سُوءاً يُجْزَ بِهِ. 2- Interrogative: as in the verse we are dealing with, مَنْ بَعَثَنا مِنْ مَرْقَدِنا?, and His saying, the Exalted, وَمَنْ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ — it is interrogative imbued with the meaning of negation. And if it is said: من ذا لقيت؟ "Whom did you meet?", then من is a mubtadaʾ and ذا is a relative in the sense of الذي, in the position of nominative as khabar; and according to the view of the Kufans on the redundancy of nouns, (ذا) may be redundant (zāʾida), and من a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb لقيت.
What most hold is that (من ذا) cannot be considered a single unit in the i'rab like (ماذا), contrary to some of them.
3- Relative, in the sense of الذي, as in His saying, the Exalted, أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَسْجُدُ لَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّماواتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ. 4- An indefinite noun that is described (nakira mawṣūfa); for this reason (رب) enters upon it in the poet's saying:
ربّ من أنضجت غيظا قلبه ... قد تمنّى لي موتا لم يطع
(Many a one whose heart I have made seethe with rage has wished death for me — he was not obeyed.)
And it is described by an indefinite noun in such as their saying: (مررت بمن معجب لك) "I passed by someone admiring you".
And Ḥassān, may Allah be pleased with him, said:
فكفى بنا فضلا على من غيرنا ... حبّ النبي محمد إيّانا
(It suffices us as a merit over anyone other than us — the Prophet Muhammad's love for us.)

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab:
(إن كانت.. فإذا هم) its i'rab has passed [Note: In verse (29) of this sūra.], and the pronoun in (كانت) refers to the second blowing (of the Trumpet); (جميع لدينا محضرون) its i'rab has passed [Note: In verse (32) of this sūra.].
The clause «إن كانت إلّا صيحة..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

safi-cedvel:54-54.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (اليوم) an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), accusative, attached to the negated (تظلم); (نفس) the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (شيئا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar [Note: Or a direct object (mafʿūl bihi), accusative.]; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negating, and the nāʾib fāʿil is the pronoun in (تجزون); (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive by the omitted preposition — or in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition — and the referring pronoun is omitted.], and the interpreted maṣdar (ما كنتم ...) is in the position of genitive by an omitted باء [Translator's note: the source has «بياء» "by a yāʾ"; «بباء» "by a bāʾ" is evidently intended.], attached to (تجزون), i.e. تجزون بعملكم "you are recompensed for your deeds".
The clause «لا تظلم نفس ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the object of an implied saying, i.e. it is said to them: اليوم يجري الحساب فلا تظلم نفس ... "Today the reckoning takes place, so no soul will be wronged ...".
The clause «لا تجزون إلّا ما ...» is conjoined to the clause لا تظلم نفس.
The clause «كنتم تعملون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «تعملون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كنتم.

safi-cedvel:55-59.t:
* I'rab:
(اليوم) an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), accusative, attached to (فاكهون); (في شغل) attached to an omitted first khabar (predicate) [Note: Or attached to (فاكهون), according to the view of al-ʿUkbarī.].
The clause «إنّ أصحاب ... فاكهون» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
(56) - (أزواجهم) conjoined by (الواو) to the mubtadaʾ (subject) (هم), nominative; (في ظلال) attached to an omitted first khabar [Note: Or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (متكئون).]; (على الأرائك) attached to the second khabar (متّكئون).
The clause «هم ... متّكئون» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption [Note: Or in the position of nominative as a third khabar of the particle resembling the verb.].
(57) - (لهم) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ فاكهة; (فيها) attached to a ḥāl of فاكهة [Note: Or attached to the "being settled" (istiqrār) to which (لهم) is attached.]; the second (لهم) is a khabar of the mubtadaʾ ما [Note: And it is a relative noun, or an indefinite noun that is described (nakira mawṣūfa) — the referring pronoun being omitted — or a maṣdar-forming particle.].
The clause «لهم فيها فاكهة ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption [Note: Or in the position of nominative as a fourth khabar of the particle resembling the verb.].
The clause «لهم ما يدّعون..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لهم فيها فاكهة.
The clause «يدّعون..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative [Note: nominal or particle relative; or it is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of (ما), it being an indefinite noun that is described.].
(58) - (سلام) mubtadaʾ, nominative [Note: Beginning with an indefinite noun is permissible because it indicates generality, namely praise.. It may be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هو, i.e. ما يدّعون; it may be a khabar of (ما) يدّعون.. or it is a badal (substitute) of (ما) according to the view of al-Zamakhsharī, or it is an adjective of (ما) as an indefinite noun that is described.], its khabar being omitted [Note: It is (عليكم), or the clause يقال قولا.. Moreover, the khabar may be (من ربّ).]; (قولا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, accusative; (من ربّ) attached to a naʿt of (قولا) [Note: Or a naʿt of سلام if it is a khabar, the clause between the adjective and what it qualifies being parenthetical; or it is the khabar of سلام.
(5, 6) Or it is the object of an implied saying, in the position of accusative.].
The clause «سلام قولا..» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption «5». (59) - (اليوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (امتازوا); (أيّها) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite noun (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of accusative.. (المجرمون) a badal of أيّ — or a naʿt — or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of it; it follows it in the nominative in form.
The clause «امتازوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive «6». The clause «أيّها المجرمون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(55) شغل: a noun from (شغل) of the فتح class (bāb fataḥa), or it is the maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb; its pattern is فعل with two ḍammas.
(فاكهون): plural of فاكه, an active participle of the three-letter verb فكه of the فرح class, from الفكاهة — with fatḥa on the fāʾ — which is taking delight and enjoying comfort; the pattern of the singular is فاعل.
(57) فاكهة: a collective noun (ism jamʿ) meaning fruits, or what is enjoyed by eating; its plural is فواكه on the pattern فواعل, and the pattern of فاكهة is فاعلة.
(يدّعون): imperfect of ادّعى; it contains a weak-letter change by omission (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf). Its original form is يدّعيون: the ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so it was given sukūn and the vowel of the yāʾ was transferred to the ʿayn — iʿlāl by sukūn — then (the yāʾ) was omitted because it met, being quiescent, with the wāw of the plural — iʿlāl by omission.. The word also contains a substitution (ibdāl): (ادّعى) was originally ادتعى on the pattern افتعل; when the تاء of iftiʿāl came after the دال, it was changed into a دال, then the two دال's were assimilated together, so it became ادّعى, its imperfect being يدّعي.

* Rhetoric:
Indefiniteness and vagueness (al-tankīr wa-l-ibhām): in His saying, the Exalted, «فِي شُغُلٍ فاكِهُونَ».
The indefiniteness and vagueness are to announce that it is raised above the rank of description; what is meant by it is the kinds of delights they are in, which divert them entirely from everything else.

safi-cedvel:60-64.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for rebuking interrogation; (إليكم) attached to (أعهد); (أن) an explicative particle [Note: Or a maṣdar-forming particle.. and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by an implied باء, attached to (أعهد).]; (لا) of prohibition, putting the verb in the jussive; (لكم) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the khabar (predicate) عدوّ.
The clause «لم أعهد ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يا بني آدم ...» has no grammatical position: parenthetical.
The clause «لا تعبدوا..» has no grammatical position: explicative.
The clause «إنّه لكم عدو ...» has no grammatical position: giving the reason.
(61) - (الواو) conjunction; (أن) like the first ...
The clause «اعبدوني..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the explicative clause.
The clause «هذا صراط ...» has no grammatical position: giving the reason for the command to worship.
(62) - (الواو) conjunction; (اللام) the lām of the oath; (قد) a particle of verification (taḥqīq); (منكم) attached to a ḥāl of (جبلّا); (الهمزة) for interrogation; (الفاء) conjunction ...
The clause «أضلّ ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the oath.. and the implied oath clause has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لم أعهد ...
The clause «لم تكونوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. أفقدتم صوابكم فلم تكونوا تعقلون "Did you lose your senses, so that you did not use reason ...".
The clause «تعقلون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of تكونوا.
(63) - (جهنّم) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هذه [Note: Or a badal (substitute) of هذه, and the khabar is the clause اصلوها.]; (التي) in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of جهنّم ...
The clause «هذه جهنّم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كنتم توعدون..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (التي).
The clause «توعدون..» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كنتم.
(64) - (اليوم) an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), accusative, attached to (اصلوها); (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive by (الباء), and the referring pronoun is omitted.] ...
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كنتم تكفرون ...) is in the position of genitive by (الباء), attached to (اصلوها), and (الباء) is causal.
The clause «اصلوها ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كنتم تكفرون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «تكفرون..» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كنتم.

* Morphology:
(62) جبلّا: a collective noun (ism jamʿ) meaning a body of creatures; its pattern is فعل with kasra on the fāʾ and the ʿayn and a doubled lām.
(64) اصلوها: it contains a weak-letter change by omission (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf). Its original form in the imperfect is يصلاونها; when it was moved to the imperative, the نون was dropped, and the alif was omitted in the imperfect and the imperative because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the letter before the wāw remained with fatḥa as an indication of the omitted alif..
Its pattern is افعوها.

* Rhetoric:
1- The tanwīn of صراط: in His saying, the Exalted, «هذا صِراطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ».
In it there is magnification and concision; it points to what He enjoined upon them of disobeying Satan and obeying the Most Merciful, since there is no path more upright than it.
2- Indefiniteness (al-tankīr): in His saying, the Exalted, «صِراطٌ»:
The indefiniteness is for intensification and magnification, i.e. this is a path consummate in its uprightness, comprising everything it ought to be, and a root of a rank which description and definition fall short of; for this reason He did not say هذا الصراط المستقيم or هذا هو الصراط المستقيم, even though that would convey restriction (ḥaṣr).
3- Putting the prohibition before the command: in His saying, the Exalted, «أَنْ لا تَعْبُدُوا الشَّيْطانَ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ وَأَنِ اعْبُدُونِي هذا صِراطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ».
The prohibition is put before the command because emptying (takhliya) has the right to precede adorning (taḥliya).

safi-cedvel:65-67.t:
* I'rab:
(اليوم) an adverb, accusative, attached to (نختم); (على أفواهم) [Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is أفواههم.] attached to (نختم); (بما كانوا يكسبون) like بما كنتم تكفرون [Note: In the preceding verse (64).], and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (تشهد).
The clause «نختم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تكلّمنا أيديهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «تشهد أرجلهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «كانوا يكسبون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal or particle relative (ما).
The clause «يكسبون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.
(66) (الواو) conjunction; (لو) a conditional particle that does not put the verb in the jussive; (اللام) linking the apodosis of لو; (على أعينهم) attached to (طمسنا); (الفاء) conjunction in both places; (الصراط) accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. إلى الصراط [Note: It may be made a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension of usage.]; (أنّى) an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) — it has come in the sense of كيف "how" — its governor being يبصرون.
The clause «نشاء ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «طمسنا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the non-jussive condition.
The clause «استبقوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis.
The clause «يبصرون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause استبقوا.
(67) (الواو) conjunction; (لو نشاء.. مضيّا) like لو نشاء.. الصراط, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (مسخناهم); (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negating....
The clause «نشاء (the second)» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause نشاء (the first).
The clause «مسخناهم ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of the non-jussive condition.
The clause «ما استطاعوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «لا يرجعون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ما استطاعوا.

* Morphology:
(مضيّا): a maṣdar (verbal noun) known by hearsay (samāʿī) of the three-letter verb مضى of the ضرب class; its pattern is فعول with ḍamma on the fāʾ. It contains a weak-letter change by conversion (iʿlāl bi-l-qalb), because the wāw met the yāʾ — مضوي — with the first of them quiescent: the wāw was changed into a yāʾ and assimilated into the other yāʾ, then the ḍād was given kasra to suit the yāʾ, so it became مضيّ.

* Rhetoric:
Metonymy (kināya): in His saying, the Exalted, «الْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلى أَفْواهِهِمْ»:
It is a metonymy for preventing them from speaking, and there is nothing to prevent there being a real sealing of their mouths. And the sealing may be borrowed for the meaning of preventing, by likening the production of a state in their mouths that prevents speech to real sealing, then "sealing" is borrowed for it, and نختم is derived from it; so the metaphor is dependent (tabaʿiyya), i.e. today We prevent their mouths from speech with a prevention resembling sealing.

safi-cedvel:68-68.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (من) a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (في الخلق) attached to (ننكسه); (الهمزة) for interrogation..
The clause «من نعمّره ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «نعمّره» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis together.].
The clause «ننكّسه ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) not joined with الفاء.
The clause «يعقلون..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. أيجهلون فلا يعقلون "Are they ignorant, so that they do not use reason?".

safi-cedvel:69-70.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) negating in both places, and the fāʿil (agent) of (ينبغي) is a pronoun referring to الشعر; (له) attached to (ينبغي); (إن) negating; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (ذكر) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هو, nominative.
The clause «ما علّمناه الشعر ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ما ينبغي له..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause [Note: It may be parenthetical.].
The clause «إن هو إلّا ذكر» has no grammatical position: giving the reason.
(70) (اللام) for giving the reason; (ينذر) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the لام, and the agent is a pronoun referring to the Qur'an; (من) a relative in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الواو) conjunction; (يحقّ) imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (ينذر); (على الكافرين) attached to (يحقّ).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن ينذر) is in the position of genitive by the لام, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being (أنزل) "He sent down".
The clause «ينذر ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «كان حيّا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «يحقّ القول ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ينذر..

* Morphology:
(الشعر): a noun for metred, rhymed speech; its plural is أشعار, and the pattern of الشعر is فعل with kasra then sukūn.

* Benefits:
- The Prophet ﷺ and poetry:
It is said that the disbelievers of Quraysh said: "Muhammad is a poet, and what he says is poetry", so Allah the Exalted sent down, giving them the lie: وَما عَلَّمْناهُ الشِّعْرَ وَما يَنْبَغِي لَهُ, i.e. that was not easy for him, nor did it come properly from him, such that if he had wanted to compose poetry it would not have been possible for him. The scholars said: not a single verse of poetry would come out metrically for him, and if he quoted a verse of poetry it ran on his tongue broken. As
it is narrated from al-Ḥasan that the Prophet ﷺ used to quote this verse:
كفى بالإسلام والشيب للمرء ناهيا. So Abū Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, said: "O Prophet of Allah, the poet only said: كفى الشيب والإسلام للمرء ناهيا (Grey hair and Islam suffice as a restrainer for a man). I bear witness that you are the Messenger of Allah (وما علمناه الشعر وما ينبغي له)." And the Lady ʿĀʾisha, may Allah the Exalted be pleased with her, was asked: "Did the Prophet ﷺ quote anything of poetry?" She said: "Poetry was the most hateful of speech to him, and he did not quote except the verse of the brother of Banū Qays, Ṭarafa:
ستبدي لك الأيام ما كنت جاهلا ... ويأتيك بالأخبار من لم تزودّ
(The days will reveal to you what you did not know, and one you did not provision will bring you the news.)
and he began to say: ويأتيك من لم تزود بالأخبار. Abū Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, said: 'It is not like that, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'I am not a poet, nor is it fitting for me.'" However, it is authentically established from the hadith of Jundab ibn ʿAbd Allāh, which al-Bukhārī and Muslim narrated, that the Prophet ﷺ was struck by a stone and his finger bled, and he said: هل أنت إلا أصبع دميت ... وفي سبيل الله ما لقيت (Are you anything but a finger that has bled? And in the way of Allah is what you have met.)
And he used to say at Ḥunayn:
أنا النبي لا كذب ... أنا ابن عبد المطلب
(I am the Prophet, no lie; I am the son of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib.)

But the coming of such speech on his tongue ﷺ was without artifice or effort; it simply happened to him thus without intending it, even if it came out metrical, just as in much of people's speech, in their sermons, letters and conversations, there occurs metrical speech that falls within the metre of the poetic metres. Moreover, al-Khalīl did not count the hemistich-form (mashṭūr) of rajaz as poetry, bearing in mind that this rare little is not taken as a basis for analogy, and none of all the hadiths of the Prophet ﷺ contained anything of poetry.
The ruling on poetry in Islam:
Islam did not wage war on poetry; he ﷺ used to urge Ḥassān, may Allah be pleased with him, saying to him:
(اهجهم وجبريل معك) "Satirise them, and Jibrīl is with you." The jurists are agreed that poetry is only speech among other speech: if it calls to a virtue or noble character, there is no harm in it and it is something good, and its author does not fall under His saying, the Exalted, وَالشُّعَراءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الْغاوُونَ, because when this verse was revealed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cleared Kaʿb, Ḥassān and ʿAbd Allāh ibn Rawāḥa, may Allah be pleased with them, of its ruling applying to them.
But if it contains reprehensible speech and falsehood, or is harnessed to stir up hatreds, or to assail people's honour, or to fight the truth, then this is the blameworthy poetry, whose author falls under His saying, the Exalted, وَالشُّعَراءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الْغاوُونَ. And Allah knows best.

safi-cedvel:71-73.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation; (الواو) conjunction; (أنّا) a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters) and its ism; (لهم) attached to (خلقنا); (ممّا) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (أنعاما); (الفاء) resumptive; (لها) attached to (مالكون), the khabar (predicate).
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّا خلقنا..) is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of يروا.
The clause «لم يروا..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.:
أغفلوا ولم يروا.. "Were they heedless and did they not see..".
The clause «خلقنا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أنّ.
The clause «عملت أيدينا..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما), and the referring pronoun is omitted.
The clause «هم لها مالكون» has no grammatical position: resumptive [Note: The content of the clause is a description of the cattle, so there is nothing to prevent making the clause redundant (zāʾida) for mere linking [Translator's note: so in the source, «الجملة زائدة»; perhaps the الفاء is meant].].
(72) (الواو) conjunction; (لهم) attached to (ذلّلناها); (الفاء) of consequence (tafrīʿiyya); (منها) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) ركوبهم; the second (منها) is attached to (يأكلون).
The clause «ذلّلناها ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause خلقنا.
The clause «منها ركوبهم..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يأكلون..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause منها ركوبهم.
(73) (الواو) conjunction; (لهم) attached to a fronted khabar; (فيها) attached to a ḥāl of منافع, the postponed mubtadaʾ; (الهمزة) for disapproving interrogation; (الفاء) conjunction; (لا) negating..
The clause «لهم فيها منافع ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause منها ركوبهم.
The clause «لا يشكرون..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. أجحدوا ذلك فلا يشكرون "Did they deny that, so that they do not give thanks?".

* Morphology:
(ركوبهم): a noun for the animals that are ridden; its plural is ركائب; the pattern of ركوب is فعول with fatḥa on the fāʾ, and of the plural فعائل.

safi-cedvel:74-76.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive — or a conjunction; (من دون) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (الواو) in (ينصرون) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «اتّخذوا..» has no grammatical position: resumptive [Note: Or conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. ما شكروا واتّخذوا "they did not give thanks and they took".].
The clause «لعلّهم ينصرون» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of اتّخذوا, the linking pronoun being omitted, i.e. لعلّهم ينصرون بهم "that they might be helped by them".. or a naʿt (adjective) of آلهة.].
The clause «ينصرون..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ.
(75) (لا) negating; (الواو) conjunction; (لهم) attached to a ḥāl of جند; (محضرون) a naʿt of جند — or a second khabar. The clause «لا يستطيعون..» has no grammatical position: another explanatory resumption.
The clause «هم ... جند..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لا يستطيعون [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the third-person pronoun in (نصرهم), according to one of the views in the interpretation of the verse.].
(76) (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (لا) of prohibition, putting the verb in the jussive; (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb and its ism; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of accusative, the referring pronoun being omitted, in both places.].
The interpreted maṣdar (ما يسرّون) is in the position of accusative as the direct object.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما يعلنون) is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the first interpreted maṣdar.
The clause «لا يحزنك قولهم ...» is in the position of jussive [Translator's note: so in the source; i.e. as the apodosis of] an implied condition, i.e. إن قالوا ما يؤذيك فلا يحزنك قولهم ... "If they say what hurts you, then let their saying not grieve you ...".
The clause «إنّا نعلم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive, giving the reason.
The clause «نعلم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «يسرّون..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «يعلنون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second particle-relative (ما).

safi-cedvel:77-78.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation of rebuke and wonder; (الواو) resumptive; (أنّا) a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters) and its ism; (من نطفة) attached to (خلقناه)..
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّا خلقناه ...) is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of يرى.
(الفاء) conjunction; (إذا) of surprise (fujāʾiyya); (مبين) a naʿt (adjective) of خصيم, nominative.
The clause «لم ير ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «خلقناه ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of أنّ.
The clause «هو خصيم..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
(78) (الواو) conjunction in both places, and circumstantial (ḥāliyya) in the third; (لنا) attached to (ضرب) [Note: Or to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), by making (ضرب) include the meaning of جعل.]; (من) an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject)..
The clause «ضرب....» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause هو خصيم.
The clause «نسي ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ضرب [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of ضرب.].
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «من يحيي ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يحيي ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «هي رميم..» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

* Morphology:
(رميم): a derived adjective in the sense of فاعل or مفعول; its pattern is فعيل. The تاء (of the feminine) did not attach to it, either because it is in the sense of مفعول, or because the nominal character predominates in it when it is in the sense of فاعل. It is from رمّ of the ضرب class.

* Rhetoric:
Excellence of exposition (ḥusn al-bayān): in His saying, the Exalted, «وَضَرَبَ لَنا مَثَلًا وَنَسِيَ خَلْقَهُ»:
Excellence of exposition is bringing out the meaning in the finest forms that make it clear, and conveying it to the understanding of the one addressed by the nearest and easiest ways. Its expression may come by way of concision (ījāz), or by way of amplification (iṭnāb), according to what the situation requires; and the exposition of the Mighty Book has come in this verse by both ways, so it is comprehensive and conclusive in decisive argument against the opponent.

* Benefits:
- Bringing the dead to life:
This verse has made clear that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, who created man from a drop of fluid, is able to give him life once again after he has become decayed bones; and Allah, Mighty and Majestic, who created man — when he was not a thing worth mentioning — is able to bring him back once again.
This verse was revealed concerning Umayya ibn Khalaf al-Jumaḥī: he disputed with the Prophet ﷺ in denying the resurrection, and brought him a bone that had decayed and crumbled, crushed it in his hand and said: "Do you think Allah will give life to this after it has decayed?" The Prophet ﷺ said: "Yes, and He will resurrect you and put you into the Fire." And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ spoke the truth, for Umayya died in disbelief on the day of Badr, and guidance was not written for him.

safi-cedvel:79-80.t:
* I'rab:
(أوّل) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, so it is an adjective of it; (الواو) conjunction; (بكلّ) attached to عليم.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يحييها....» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أنشأها ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «هو ... عليم» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
(80) - (الذي) a relative, a badal (substitute) of the first relative, the fāʿil (agent) of يحييها; (لكم) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من الشجر) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of نارا; (الفاء) conjunction; (إذا أنتم منه توقدون) like إذا هو خصيم مبين [Note: In verse (77) of this sūra.]; (منه) attached to (توقدون).
The clause «جعل....» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (الذي).
The clause «أنتم منه توقدون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause, connected with it by a causal link, following it..
The clause «توقدون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (أنتم).

* Morphology:
(الأخضر): a noun indicating colour, used in the domain of description; its pattern is أفعل.

safi-cedvel:81-83.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation of wonder and disapproval; (الواو) conjunction; (قادر) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of ليس; (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخلق ...) is in the position of genitive, attached to قادر.
(بلى) a particle of response affirming the negated question, i.e. بلى هو قادر "Yes indeed, He is able"; (الواو) conjunction; (العليم) a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هو.
The clause «ليس الذي خلق ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. أليس الذي أنشأ المخلوقات أوّل مرّة، وليس الذي خلق السموات ... "Is not He who produced the creatures the first time, and is not He who created the heavens ...".
The clause «خلق....» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «يخلق ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «هو الخلاق ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. بلى هو قادر على ذلك وهو الخلاق ... "Yes indeed, He is able to do that, and He is the Creator ...".
(82) (إنّما) a restraining particle (kāffa) and the restrained (makfūfa); (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle; (له) attached to (يقول); (كن) a complete (tāmm) imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) being أنت, and likewise the imperfect (يكون), its agent being هو; (الفاء) before يكون is a conjunction — or resumptive. The interpreted maṣdar (أن يقول..) is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أمره).
The clause «أمره.. أن يقول..» has no grammatical position: resumptive, having the force of giving the reason.
The clause «أراد شيئا ...» is in the position of genitive as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. فأمره قوله له كن "then His command is His saying to it 'Be'".. The condition, its protasis and its apodosis are parenthetical.
The clause «يقول ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «كن..» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يكون..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هو, and the nominal clause has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أمره.. أن يقول [Note: Or it is resumptive..].
(83) (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (سبحان) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb; (بيده) attached to a fronted khabar of the postponed mubtadaʾ ملكوت; (الواو) conjunction; (إليه) attached to (ترجعون), and (الواو) in it is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause « (سبّح) سبحان..» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. إن كان أمره كذلك فسبّحه "If His command is thus, then glorify Him".
The clause «بيده ملكوت ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «ترجعون..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.

safi-cedvel:1-1.t: Two disjointed letters (ḥurūf muqaṭṭaʿa) with no grammatical position.

safi-cedvel:2-11.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) the wāw of oath; (القرآن) genitive by the wāw, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being أقسم ("I swear").
The clause «(أقسم) بالقرآن ...» has no grammatical position: inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya).
(3- 5) (اللام) the lām of the oath, in place of the shifted [lām] (al-muzaḥlaqa); (من المرسلين) attached to the khabar (predicate) of (إنّ); (على صراط) attached to the omitted khabar [Note: Or attached to the active participle المرسلين.]; (تنزيل) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb; (الرحيم) naʿt (adjective) of العزيز, genitive like it..
The clause «إنّك لمن المرسلين» has no grammatical position: the response to the oath (jawāb al-qasam).
The clause «(نزّل) تنزيل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
(6) (اللام) causal (li-l-taʿlīl); (تنذر) an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن after the lām; (ما) negative [Note: Or relative, or an indefinite noun qualified [by an adjective], or redundant.]; (آباؤهم) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (الفاء) a conjunction..
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن تنذر ...) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to the maṣdar standing in for its verb, تنزيل.
The clause «تنذر ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the concealed particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «ما أنذر آباؤهم» is in the position of accusative as naʿt of (قوما).
The clause «هم غافلون ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause ما أنذر ...
(اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath..; (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (على أكثرهم) attached to (حقّ); (الفاء) causal; (لا) negative.
The clause «قد حقّ القول ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the implied oath..
The clause of the implied oath is resumptive.
The clause «هم لا يؤمنون» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «لا يؤمنون» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (هم).
(8) (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb, and its noun (ism); (في أعناقهم) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الفاء), the first, redundant (zāʾida) for mere linking; (إلى الأذقان) attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ هي [Note: This pronoun refers to the hands in which the shackles were placed, which are understood from the context.].. (الفاء), the second, a conjunction..
The clause «إنّا جعلنا ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «جعلنا ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of إنّ.
The clause «هي إلى الأذقان ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «هم مقمحون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هي الأذقان.
(9) (الواو) a conjunction; (من بين) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi, its governor being جعلنا, and likewise (من خلفهم); so (الواو) conjoins the first object to the first and the second object to the second; (الفاء) a conjunction in both places..
The clause «جعلنا ... (the second)» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause جعلنا (the first).
The clause «أغشيناهم ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause جعلنا (the second).
The clause «هم لا يبصرون» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause أغشيناهم.
The clause «لا يبصرون» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
(10) (الواو) a conjunction; (سواء) a fronted khabar of the postponed mubtadaʾ, the interpreted maṣdar; (عليهم) attached to سواء; (الهمزة) a maṣdar-forming particle of equivalence (taswiya); (أم) a conjunction balancing the hamza; (لا) negative..
The interpreted maṣdar (أأنذرتهم) is in the position of nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ.
The clause «سواء عليهم (إنذارك) ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّا جعلنا.
The clause «أنذرتهم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (الهمزة).
The clause «لم تنذرهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنذرتهم.
The clause «لا يؤمنون» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
(11) (إنّما) the restraining and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (بالغيب) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent or the object; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition; (بمغفرة) attached to (بشّره)..
The clause «إنما تنذر ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «اتّبع ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «خشي ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause اتّبع.
The clause «بشّره» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. whoever follows the Reminder.. then give him glad tidings.

* Morphology:
(8) مقمحون: plural of مقمح, passive participle of the four-letter verb (أقمح); its pattern is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Representative metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya): in the words of the Exalted «إِنَّا جَعَلْنا فِي أَعْناقِهِمْ أَغْلالًا».
He represented their determination upon disbelief, and that there is no way to their desisting, by making them like the shackled ones with heads forced up, in that they do not turn to the truth, nor bend their necks towards it, nor lower their heads to it; and like those placed between two barriers, who see neither what is before them nor what is behind them: in that they have no reflection and no insight, and that they feign blindness to looking at the signs of Allah.
2- Representative metaphor: in the words of the Exalted «وَجَعَلْنا مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا».
He likened them to those surrounded by two enormous barriers which have covered their sight, so that they see neither before them nor behind them, in that they are imprisoned in this ignorance, prevented from looking at the signs and proofs. Or [it is] as though they — having been deprived of the blessing of reflecting on past generations and bygone nations, and of contemplating the coming hidden things and the future outcomes — have been surrounded by a barrier in front of them and a barrier behind them, so they are in a dark gloom, in whose direction the eye does not flicker at any spark, nor discern a glimmer of hope.

safi-cedvel:12-12.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّا) a particle resembling the verb, and its noun (ism); (نحن) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: Or an emphasis (tawkīd) of the attached pronoun (نا), the noun of إنّ, and [a nominative pronoun] has been borrowed for the accusative position.]; (الواو) a conjunction; (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the returning pronoun is omitted; (آثارهم) conjoined to the relative noun by the conjunction, accusative; (كلّ) mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb explained by what follows it; (في إمام) attached to (أحصيناه)..
The clause «إنّا نحن نحيي ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «نحن نحيي ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «نحيي الموتى ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (نحن).
The clause «نكتب ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause نحيي.
The clause «قدّموا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «(أحصينا) كلّ شيء..» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause نكتب.
The clause «أحصينا ...» has no grammatical position: explicative (tafsīriyya).

safi-cedvel:13-14.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, and the address in (اضرب) is to the Messenger, upon him be peace; (لهم) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (مثلا) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (أصحاب) a badal (substitute) of (مثلا), accusative like it [Note: With a muḍāf omitted, i.e. the story of the people of the town.. It is also permissible that (أصحاب) be the first object and (مثلا) the second object, with (لهم) attached to (اضرب).]; (إذ) an adverb, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as a badal of أصحاب, a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl).
The clause «اضرب ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «جاءها المرسلون» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
(إذ), the second, a badal of the first, a complete badal (badal kull); (إليهم) attached to (أرسلنا); (الفاء) a conjunction in the three places; (بثالث) attached to (عزّزنا), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "with a third messenger"; (إليكم) attached to the khabar (predicate) (مرسلون).
The clause «أرسلنا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «كذّبوهما» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause أرسلنا.
The clause «عزّزنا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause كذبوهما.
The clause «قالوا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause عزّزنا.
The clause «إنّا إليكم مرسلون» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).

* Rhetoric:
Ellipsis (al-ḥadhf): in the words of the Exalted «فَعَزَّزْنا بِثالِثٍ»:
The object of عززنا has been omitted, the implied form being "so We reinforced the two of them with a third". It inclined to this omission only because the purpose is to mention the one with whom the reinforcement was made, namely Shamʿūn, and the subtle planning in it, until the truth became mighty and falsehood abased. When speech is directed towards one of the purposes, its context is made for it and turned towards it, as though anything else were rejected and discarded. Its parallel is your saying: "The sultan judged today with the truth": the purpose to which [the speech] is driven is your saying "with the truth", and for that reason you dispensed with mentioning the one judged for and the one judged against.

* Benefits:
- The people of the town. The scholars of the reports of the prophets said: ʿĪsā, upon him be blessing and peace, sent two messengers from the disciples (Ṣādiq and Ṣadūq). When they drew near the city, they saw an old man herding some sheep of his, namely Ḥabīb the carpenter. He asked about them, and they said: "We are the two messengers of ʿĪsā; we call you from the worship of idols to the worship of the Most Merciful." He said: "Do you have a sign with you?" They said: "We heal the sick and cure the one born blind and the leper." He had a son who had been sick for two years; they wiped him and he stood up.
